controls.basis: Horizontal controls derive from separately attributed original OSM traces. Exact-QID relation 2270819 supplies palace identity and courtyard. Mapped part heights often explicitly state they are estimated. All authored vertical sections, 8.2m provisional terrace offset, roof partitions, gallery bay counts, apertures and copper helm profiles remain original photographic estimates; no primary surveyed palace height verified.

nativeAxes.front: West Berrecci entry; native +X east and +Z south
nativeAxes.longitudinal: +Z along eastern palace wing; coordinates bake all footprint angles
nativeAxes.origin: Palace research reference anchor. Provisional courtyard attachment Y8.2; Senator tower toe Y0. Actual sloped hill and floor datum unverified.

reconstruction.scope: Current royal palace exterior, open Renaissance courtyard and three-tier galleries, western Berrecci passage, southern curtain wall, northern Sobieski and Sigismund III copper helms, eastern Danish pavilion/Jordanka and adjacent Senator tower.
reconstruction.basis: Original geometry from attributed current map traces and primary museum/city architectural photographs. No downloaded mesh, photo texture or traced printed drawing.
reconstruction.referenceState: Current exterior interpretation. Cathedral, detached Sandomierska/Thieves towers, other hill buildings and gardens are separate geographic objects and outside this palace asset.
